detail.body:
## What does this PR do?

Prevent FSDP DTensor checkpoint collisions between pipeline stages by applying Megatron-Core's global-layer naming handler on both save and load. Without it, stages can write different model weights and Adam moments under identical stage-local keys; a successful load can then silently resume from incorrect state. This affects dense GPT as well as hybrid Nemotron models.

Depends on https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/8159, which contains the shared checkpoint handler, FSDP v1 PP mesh fix, and shared-embedding gradient reduction fixes. That Core PR depends on https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/8010 for meta-device embedding initialization. Keep this draft until that dependency is available.

## Changelog

- Apply the global-layer handler after transformations that resolve live modules by local name, preserving tensor aliases used by in-place loading.
- Preserve v2 preprocessing; its optimizer keys are already global.
- Retain compatibility with older Core for PP=1; raise a clear error for PP>1 when the handler is unavailable.
- Test handler invocation and both old-Core compatibility cases.

PP=1 checkpoint keys remain unchanged. Checkpoints already affected by stage-local collisions have omitted stage-specific tensors and need to be regenerated; this change cannot reconstruct them.

## Validation

- Six focused Bridge checkpoint tests passed with the updated Core source.
- All-files pre-commit passed. Strict mypy was run but is not clean on the baseline (missing local dependencies and existing typing errors); no clean type-check claim.
- Revised Core #8159 gradient regression: 96 cases passed on each of eight H100 ranks, in addition to 26 unchanged mesh and 16 checkpoint cases.
- Lightning PP=2/EP=2/MTP=2 with #8010 (`5920bd95`) plus Core #8159: checkpoint weights and Adam state restore exactly, next loss/gradient norm match exactly, and all 287 post-step model/Adam tensors match numerically (maximum absolute difference 4.331e-8).
- Full 52-layer Lightning with #8010 plus Core #8159: three forward/backward/optimizer steps completed on eight H100s, PP=2/EP=2/TP=1/CP=1, original widths/128 experts/vocabulary, MTP=2 and synthetic sequence length 256. Loss 12.176648 → 10.490705 → 9.382988, no skipped/NaN iterations; peak allocated memory 69.898 GiB. BF16 Adam moments fit this full-size smoke on one node; checkpoint restart was validated with the smaller FP32-moment run above.

Training probes use function-level patch injection into NeMo 26.08.01 and include #8010 plus the existing upstream embedding-gradient reduction fix from NVIDIA/Megatron-LM#6486.

The training probes set `model.deallocate_pipeline_outputs=False`, required for the output views returned by FSDP v1 hooks. Short synthetic-data runs establish correctness for the tested configurations, not convergence or performance.

Independent subagent review completed before publication; no blocking findings.

## Before this PR is ready for review

- [x] Followed contributor guidelines; signed and signed-off commit.
- [x] Added focused regression coverage.
- [x] Documented dependency and checkpoint compatibility above.
- [x] Guarded the optional Core handler import.
- [ ] Core dependency merged and available in Bridge's Core version.

@@ -139,6 +139,12 @@
 except ImportError:
     HAVE_MEGATRON_FSDP = False
 
+try:
+    from megatron.core.transformer.fsdp_dtensor_checkpoint import handle_pipeline_parallel_in_state_dict
+except ImportError:
+    handle_pipeline_parallel_in_state_dict = None
+
+
 try:
     from megatron.core.transformer.fsdp_dtensor_checkpoint import handle_gdn_in_state_dict
 except ImportError:
@@ -2291,7 +2297,7 @@ def preprocess_fsdp_dtensor_state_dict(cfg, raw_state_dict: dict[str, Any], mode
         getattr(model_config, "gated_linear_unit", False) and getattr(model_config, "activation_func", None) is F.silu
     )
 
-    def apply(handler):
+    def apply(handler: Callable[..., tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any] | None]]) -> None:
         """Run a state dict handler over the model and, when present, the optimizer state."""
         model_state_dict, optimizer_state_dict = handler(model, state_dict["model"], state_dict.get("optimizer"))
         state_dict["model"] = model_state_dict
@@ -2324,6 +2330,16 @@ def apply(handler):
     if handle_mtp_in_state_dict is not None:
         apply(handle_mtp_in_state_dict)
 
+    # V2 optimizer keys are already global. Only v1 needs this final renaming.
+    if getattr(getattr(cfg, "ddp", None), "megatron_fsdp_version", 1) == 1:
+        if handle_pipeline_parallel_in_state_dict is not None:
+            apply(handle_pipeline_parallel_in_state_dict)
+        elif model_config.pipeline_model_parallel_size > 1:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "FSDP pipeline checkpointing requires a Megatron-Core version with "
+                "handle_pipeline_parallel_in_state_dict; older versions collide stage-local layer names."
+            )
+
     preprocess_state_dict_for_uneven_dtensor(state_dict)
 
     return state_dict

                 3.1 if hasattr(distrib_optimizer, "get_legacy_grad_dtypes") else 3.0
             )

         from unittest.mock import Mock
 
@@ -4940,12 +4941,14 @@ def test_preprocess_fsdp_dtensor_state_dict(self):
         # Create mock model and config
         mock_model = Mock()
         mock_cfg = Mock()
+        mock_cfg.ddp.megatron_fsdp_version = version

             mock_model_config = Mock()
             mock_model_config.gated_linear_unit = False
             mock_model_config.num_moe_experts = None
+            mock_model_config.pipeline_model_parallel_size = 1
             mock_get_config.return_value = mock_model_config
 
             with (
@@ -4956,15 +4959,52 @@ def test_preprocess_fsdp_dtensor_state_dict(self):
                 patch("megatron.bridge.training.checkpointing.handle_gdn_in_state_dict", None),
                 patch("megatron.bridge.training.checkpointing.handle_mla_down_proj_in_state_dict", None),
                 patch("megatron.bridge.training.checkpointing.handle_mtp_in_state_dict", None),
+                patch(
+                    "megatron.bridge.training.checkpointing.handle_pipeline_parallel_in_state_dict",
+                    side_effect=lambda model, state, optim: (state, optim),
+                ) as mock_pipeline,
             ):
                 raw_state_dict = {"model": {"test_param": torch.tensor([1.0])}}
                 result = preprocess_fsdp_dtensor_state_dict(mock_cfg, raw_state_dict, mock_model)
 
                 # Should call FP8 and uneven dtensor preprocessing
                 mock_fp8.assert_called_once()
                 mock_uneven.assert_called_once()
+                if version == 1:
+                    mock_pipeline.assert_called_once_with(mock_model, raw_state_dict["model"], None)
+                else:
+                    mock_pipeline.assert_not_called()
                 assert "model" in result
 
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("pp", [1, 2])
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("version", [1, 2])
+    def test_fsdp_pipeline_checkpoint_requires_core_handler(self, pp: int, version: int) -> None:
+        """Old Core remains usable for PP=1 but must not silently corrupt PP>1."""
+        from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+        from megatron.bridge.training import checkpointing
+
+        model_config = SimpleNamespace(gated_linear_unit=False, num_moe_experts=None, pipeline_model_parallel_size=pp)
+        with (
+            patch("megatron.core.utils.get_model_config", return_value=model_config),
+            patch.object(checkpointing, "handle_fp8_extra_state_case"),
+            patch.object(checkpointing, "preprocess_state_dict_for_uneven_dtensor"),
+            patch.multiple(
+                checkpointing,
+                handle_gdn_in_state_dict=None,
+                handle_mla_down_proj_in_state_dict=None,
+                handle_mtp_in_state_dict=None,
+                handle_pipeline_parallel_in_state_dict=None,
+            ),
+        ):
+            state = {"model": {"weight": torch.ones(1)}}
+            cfg = SimpleNamespace(ddp=SimpleNamespace(megatron_fsdp_version=version))
+            if pp > 1 and version == 1:
+                with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="collide stage-local layer names"):
+                    checkpointing.preprocess_fsdp_dtensor_state_dict(cfg, state, None)
+            else:
+                assert checkpointing.preprocess_fsdp_dtensor_state_dict(cfg, state, None) == state
+
